read: Festival crowd demands explosive energy and immediate hooks; visual impact supersedes musical nuance for 15,000 fans.

tracks.title: Greyhound
tracks.why: Opening cannon shot: driving bass commands attention instantly.
tracks.transition: Match kick drum roll into Zombie Nation's seismic intro.

tracks.title: Kernkraft 400 (Sport Chant Stadium Remix)
tracks.why: Simple synth hook penetrates entire field, unifying rave.
tracks.transition: Hard-cut during chant peak into Chemical's abrasive synth.

tracks.title: Hey Boy Hey Girl
tracks.why: Distorted hook cuts chaos; crowd shouts vocal tagline.
tracks.transition: Syncopated hi-hat exit into SICK INDIVIDUAL drop.

tracks.title: SICK INDIVIDUAL
tracks.why: Brutal minimal drop ensures maximum CO2 jet deployment.
tracks.transition: Blend distorted bass frequencies into Epic's orchestral stabs.

tracks.title: Epic
tracks.why: Monolithic riffs visible from orbit; zero interpretation needed.
tracks.transition: Flare synth outro segues into Promises' anthemic guitar.

tracks.title: Promises (David Guetta Remix)
tracks.why: Vocals anchor finale while remix keeps energy apocalyptic.
tracks.transition: Laser sweep climax across repeated chorus; freeze.
